video_title: Deion Sanders CALLED Keyshawn Over Shedeur Drama?!

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Shedeur Sanders' future as the starting quarterback for the team
quotes.excerpt: I think it's his job to lose. I think he gets opportunity.

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen Jackson
text_blocks.text: I think it's his job to lose. I think he gets opportunity. It's one of them situations where they're looking at it and they're saying to themselves, well, he is probably our future. We might as well let him run it right now. We're not going to re-sign Deion. They're not going to re-sign him.

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: You think they give him another opportunity next week?

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Shedeur Sanders' chances of starting if the current starter is healthy
quotes.excerpt: He doesn't get the opportunity. The reason he won't get the opportunity is because if Deion is healthy
quotes.quote: He doesn't get the opportunity. The reason he won't get the opportunity is because if Deion is healthy, they're probably either winning the game or they're still in the mix. They're in the mix now, but because he has such a great showing, you might want to continue to roll that way. You just might.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Joe Burrow's growth and lack of excuses this season
quotes.excerpt: He doesn't make the excuses that he made in the past when things don't go well.
quotes.quote: I like Joe. I'm liking him more than I have in the past because it was too many excuses for me. He doesn't make the excuses that he made in the past when things don't go well. He's certainly showing up. I used to always tell everybody, you just like him because he wear Cartier glasses and a mink coat. We got to judge him the same way we judge everybody else.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Ranking Joe Burrow in the current MVP race
quotes.excerpt: If I had to vote right now, I would take Brock Purdy, Josh Allen, and then I'd probably throw Joe Burrow in there somewhere.
quotes.quote: If I had to vote right now, I would take Brock Purdy, Josh Allen, and then I'd probably throw Joe Burrow in there somewhere. Because Josh Allen out there really, I mean, he got the running back, but for the most part, he out there doing his thing. He's like Luka.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Evaluating the receiving duo of Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins
quotes.excerpt: They're probably the best in the league right now.
quotes.quote: They're probably the best in the league right now. I don't know anybody else. Jefferson and Addison, but they're not getting the opportunity. They're the leader of the pack. Adams is hurt, Puka is hurt, so that's done. JSN is a lone ranger basically by himself. Williams and Amon-Ra St. Brown is legit, and if I throw the Lockett in there with them, then that helps that becomes a nice package with them three.
